name: MonarchAiMessage
title: AiMessageView
wrapsNative: VStack of the message's parts in order, each drawn by its Monarch component (MonarchAiStreamingText, MonarchAiReasoning, MonarchAiToolCall or MonarchAiToolApproval, MonarchAiSourceList, MonarchAiCitation, MonarchAttachmentChip, MonarchAiChainOfSteps, MonarchAiMemoryChip, MonarchAiArtifactCard, MonarchAiErrorMessage), with MonarchAiUserMessageEdit, MonarchAiMessageBranch and MonarchAiMessageActions; UnevenRoundedRectangle for the person's bubble
summary: One message of an AI conversation: its text, reasoning, tool calls and approvals, sources and citations, files, plan, memories, artifacts and errors in the order the model produced them, with the time, the branch switcher and the actions row.
whenToUse: For each message of MonarchAiConversation's messages in a chat screen, so every part type is drawn the same way across Rook apps.
whenNotToUse: For person-to-person chat use MonarchMessageRow. For a single answer outside a conversation (a summary card, an inline insight) use MonarchAiSummaryCard or MonarchAiInsightCallout. For only the text of a reply use MonarchAiStreamingText.
api: init(_ message: MonarchAiConversationMessage, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = nil, feedback: Binding<MonarchAiMessageFeedback?>? = nil, isReadingAloud: Binding<Bool>? = nil, isEditing: Binding<Bool>? = nil, showsTimestamp: Bool = true, showsActions: Bool = true, isCopyable: Bool = true, isShareable: Bool = false, announces: Bool = true, labels: MonarchAiMessageLabels = MonarchAiMessageLabels(), onCopy: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRegenerate: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onEditSubmit: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onBranch: (@MainActor (Int) -> Void)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onResume: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onCancelQueued: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onApproveTool: (@MainActor (_ toolCallID: String, _ input: MonarchAiJSON?) -> Void)? = nil, onDenyTool: (@MainActor (_ toolCallID: String, _ reason: String?) -> Void)? = nil, onAlwaysAllowTool: (@MainActor (_ toolName: String) -> Void)? = nil, onEditMemory: (@MainActor (_ id: String, _ text: String) -> Void)? = nil, onForgetMemory: (@MainActor (_ id: String) -> Void)? = nil, onOpenArtifact: (@MainActor (MonarchAiArtifactPart) -> Void)? = nil, onOpenSource: (@MainActor (MonarchAiSourceListItem) -> Void)? = nil, onOpenLink: (@MainActor (URL) -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder part: @escaping (MonarchAiPart) -> Part, @ViewBuilder more: () -> More)

init(_ message: MonarchAiConversationMessage, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = nil, feedback: Binding<MonarchAiMessageFeedback?>? = nil, isReadingAloud: Binding<Bool>? = nil, isEditing: Binding<Bool>? = nil, showsTimestamp: Bool = true, showsActions: Bool = true, isCopyable: Bool = true, isShareable: Bool = false, announces: Bool = true, labels: MonarchAiMessageLabels = MonarchAiMessageLabels(), onCopy: …, onRegenerate: …, onEditSubmit: …, onBranch: …, onRetry: …, onResume: …, onCancelQueued: …, onApproveTool: …, onDenyTool: …, onAlwaysAllowTool: …, onEditMemory: …, onForgetMemory: …, onOpenArtifact: …, onOpenSource: …, onOpenLink: …) where Part == EmptyView, More == EmptyView

MonarchAiMessageLabels.init(assistantSaid:youSaid:systemSaid:assistant:finishNotice:queued:cancelQueued:resume:plan:versions:previousVersion:nextVersion:versionOf:editLabel:save:cancel:streamingText:reasoning:toolCall:toolApproval:sources:citation:attachment:memory:error:actions:), every string String? = nil, finishNotice (@Sendable (MonarchAiFinishReason) -> String?)? = nil, versionOf (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, and the labels of each part's component with their defaults

options.name: message
options.description: The message: its role, parts in order, agent, time, branch, finish reason and queued flag.

options.name: agent
options.description: The agent that answered, used when the message has no agent of its own; without either the header says "Assistant".

options.name: feedback
options.description: The rating of an assistant message. Shows the thumbs in the actions row when set.

options.name: isReadingAloud
options.description: Whether the app is reading an assistant message aloud. Shows Read aloud when set; the app speaks.

options.name: isEditing
options.description: Whether the person's message is being edited. Shows Edit on the person's messages when set; Edit sets it to true and Save or Cancel set it to false. While true the bubble is replaced by MonarchAiUserMessageEdit.

options.name: showsTimestamp
options.description: Shows the time the message was created: in the header of an assistant message, in the footer of the person's.

options.name: showsActions
options.description: Shows MonarchAiMessageActions under the message.

options.name: isCopyable
options.description: Shows Copy when the message has text.

options.name: isShareable
options.description: Shows Share with the message text.

options.name: announces
options.description: Whether streaming text, the end of the reply and errors are announced. Turn off when the conversation screen announces instead.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings and for the strings of every part's component.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Runs with the copied text after each copy.

options.name: onRegenerate
options.description: Shows Regenerate on an assistant message.

options.name: onEditSubmit
options.description: Receives the edited text of the person's message, for example to resend it as a new branch; editing then ends.

options.name: onBranch
options.description: Receives the alternative chosen in the branch switcher, counted from 0. The switcher appears when the message has two or more alternatives.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Retry to an error part that can be retried.

options.name: onResume
options.description: Adds Resume to an error part whose run can be resumed.

options.name: onCancelQueued
options.description: Adds Cancel to the person's message queued while offline.

options.name: onApproveTool
options.description: Approves a tool call with the edited input, or nil when unchanged. With this or onDenyTool a waiting call is drawn as MonarchAiToolApproval.

options.name: onDenyTool
options.description: Denies a tool call with the reason the person gave, or nil.

options.name: onAlwaysAllowTool
options.description: Adds Always allow to the approval.

options.name: onEditMemory
options.description: Edits a memory from its chip's menu.

options.name: onForgetMemory
options.description: Forgets a memory from its chip's menu.

options.name: onOpenArtifact
options.description: Opens an artifact. Artifact parts are shown as MonarchAiArtifactCard only when it is set.

options.name: onOpenSource
options.description: Opens a source in the app, from the source list and the citation cards, instead of its web address.

options.name: onOpenLink
options.description: Opens a link in the text instead of the system browser.

options.name: part
options.description: Draws generative UI and edit proposal parts, which need the app's component registry or diff. Without it those parts are left out.

options.name: more
options.description: Extra items at the end of the More menu of the actions row.

states.name: assistant
states.description: A header with the decorative agent avatar, the name, the agent's role and the time, then the parts at full width and the actions row.

states.name: the person's message
states.description: A bubble in the muted fill at the trailing edge with a small corner towards the person; the time, the branch switcher and Copy and Edit under it.

states.name: streaming
states.description: The text shows its caret and announces sentences; the actions row is hidden until the reply is done.

states.name: awaiting approval
states.description: A tool call that waits for approval is drawn as MonarchAiToolApproval when onApproveTool or onDenyTool is set, otherwise as MonarchAiToolCall with its waiting state.

states.name: editing
states.description: The bubble is replaced by MonarchAiUserMessageEdit with Save and Cancel; the actions row is hidden.

states.name: queued
states.description: Under the person's message a clock and "Queued. It will send when you are back online." with Cancel; no actions.

states.name: cut short
states.description: A finished reply whose finish reason is length, content filter or refusal ends with a warning symbol and a notice.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchAiErrorMessage with the tone and actions of its kind, Retry when the error can be retried and Resume when the run can be resumed.

states.name: branches
states.description: With two or more alternatives MonarchAiMessageBranch shows the position and previous and next buttons.

appearance: The person's bubble uses the muted background role with an extra-large radius and a small bottom trailing corner; the name uses the default text colour in the strong body style, the role and time the muted text colour in the caption style; the finish notice symbol uses the strong warning colour. Each part keeps its component's colours, all theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web AiMessageView renders the same parts in the same order. On iOS callbacks capture the message, so they do not receive it again; the web's editing, onEdit and onEditCancel become the isEditing binding, and onEditSubmit receives the text. The web's renderPart, which can replace any part, becomes part, which draws only generative UI and edit proposals: on iOS the app supplies the registry or diff view through it (AiGenerativeUi's registry and AiEditProposal's hunks have no iOS equivalent in this component). The web shows its actions on hover by default; phones have no hover, so the row is always shown (actionsVisibility is not offered). Citations cannot sit inside SwiftUI text, so consecutive citation markers form a row after the text they follow. The web caps the person's bubble at 85% of the width; iOS keeps a 48-point leading inset instead, which reads the same on a phone and needs no width measurement. The time uses the environment's locale and time zone instead of a locale prop. Experimental: a product composite (the message row of an AI chat) that waits for a Rook app to adopt it. Android ships the same component, also experimental, with the same name and callbacks (onRegenerate, onBranch, onRetry, onResume, onCancelQueued, onApproveTool, onDenyTool, onAlwaysAllowTool, onEditSubmit, onEditMemory, onForgetMemory, onOpenArtifact, onOpenSource, onOpenLink). Differences in Swift idiom: Android's editing, onEdit and onEditCancel are the isEditing binding; Android's onFeedback and speaking/onReadAloud are the feedback and isReadingAloud bindings; Android's onShare callback is isShareable with the system ShareLink; Android's showTimestamp, showActions and copyable are showsTimestamp, showsActions and isCopyable; Android's timeZone and is24Hour come from the SwiftUI environment; Android's onOpenFile is not offered (a file chip with a web address opens it); Android's uiRegistry, onUiAction and editHunks are the part slot; onOpenSource receives a MonarchAiSourceListItem instead of the source part.
accessibility: The message is a container named by who said it: "You said", "Assistant said" or "System message".
The assistant header is one element with the header trait, read as the name, the agent's role and the time; the avatar is decorative.
Streaming text announces new sentences and the last text part announces the end of the reply, through MonarchAiStreamingText; announces turns both off.
A tool call's state changes and an error are announced by MonarchAiToolCall and MonarchAiErrorMessage.
Each citation is a button read as "Source 1: Ledger, March"; the source list has numbered, named sources.
The finish notice is text with a decorative warning symbol, so it does not rely on colour.
The actions, branch buttons, Resume and Cancel are standard buttons of at least 44 points.
edgeCases: A message with no visible parts shows only its header or footer.
Empty finished text parts are left out; an empty streaming text part shows the caret.
Citations that point at a source the message does not have are left out.
Sources are listed once, where the first source part stands, however many source parts follow.
Artifacts are left out without onOpenArtifact, and generative UI and edit proposals without part.
At the largest text sizes the header and footer wrap onto more lines.
An invalid createdAt hides the time.

examples.title: Assistant answer with reasoning, tool, sources and file
examples.webExample: Assistant answer with reasoning, tool, sources and file
examples.template:
MonarchAiMessage(
    MonarchAiConversationMessage(
        id: "a1",
        role: .assistant,
        parts: [
            .reasoning(MonarchAiReasoningPart(text: {{reasoning.text}}, durationMs: {{reasoning.durationMs}})),
            .toolCall(
                MonarchAiToolCallPart(
                    id: {{tool.id}},
                    name: {{tool.name}},
                    input: ["query": {{tool.query}}],
                    state: .succeeded,
                    startedAt: {{tool.startedAt}},
                    endedAt: {{tool.endedAt}}
                )),
            .text(MonarchAiTextPart(text: {{answer}})),
            .source(MonarchAiSourcePart(id: {{source.id}}, title: {{source.title}}, url: {{source.url}}, kind: {{source.kind|case}})),
            .citation(MonarchAiCitationPart(id: {{citation.id}}, sourceId: {{citation.sourceId}})),
            .file(MonarchAiFilePart(name: {{file.name}}, mediaType: {{file.mediaType}}, size: {{file.size}})),
        ],
        agent: MonarchAiAgentRef(name: {{agent.name}}, role: {{agent.role}}),
        createdAt: {{createdAt}},
        branch: MonarchAiBranchPosition(index: {{branch.index}}, count: {{branch.count}})
    ),
    feedback: $feedback,
    onRegenerate: {},
    onBranch: { _ in }
)
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: {{locale}}))
examples.code:
MonarchAiMessage(
    MonarchAiConversationMessage(
        id: "a1",
        role: .assistant,
        parts: [
            .reasoning(MonarchAiReasoningPart(text: "Find the decisions first, then the owners.", durationMs: 3000)),
            .toolCall(
                MonarchAiToolCallPart(
                    id: "t1",
                    name: "search_documents",
                    input: ["query": "meeting notes"],
                    state: .succeeded,
                    startedAt: "2026-03-02T10:15:00.000Z",
                    endedAt: "2026-03-02T10:15:01.600Z"
                )),
            .text(MonarchAiTextPart(text: "The team agreed on the launch date.\n\n- Confirm the venue\n- Share the agenda\n- Book a review")),
            .source(MonarchAiSourcePart(id: "s1", title: "Weekly meeting notes", url: "https://example.com/notes", kind: .doc)),
            .citation(MonarchAiCitationPart(id: "c1", sourceId: "s1")),
            .file(MonarchAiFilePart(name: "agenda.pdf", mediaType: "application/pdf", size: 48_000)),
        ],
        agent: MonarchAiAgentRef(name: "Assistant", role: "Writing assistant"),
        createdAt: "2026-03-02T10:15:00.000Z",
        branch: MonarchAiBranchPosition(index: 1, count: 2)
    ),
    feedback: $feedback,
    onRegenerate: {},
    onBranch: { _ in }
)
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: "en-GB"))

examples.title: The person's message with Edit and versions
examples.code:
MonarchAiMessage(
    MonarchAiConversationMessage(
        id: "u1",
        role: .user,
        parts: [.text(MonarchAiTextPart(text: text))],
        createdAt: "2026-03-10T09:41:00.000Z",
        branch: MonarchAiBranchPosition(index: version, count: 2)
    ),
    isEditing: $isEditing,
    onEditSubmit: { text = $0 },
    onBranch: { version = $0 }
)

examples.title: A tool call that waits for approval
examples.code:
MonarchAiMessage(
    MonarchAiConversationMessage(
        id: "a2",
        role: .assistant,
        parts: [
            .toolCall(
                MonarchAiToolCallPart(
                    id: "t2",
                    name: "sendEmail",
                    input: .object(["to": .string("billing@acme.test")]),
                    state: .pendingApproval,
                    risk: .high
                ))
        ],
        createdAt: "2026-03-10T09:42:00.000Z"
    ),
    onApproveTool: { id, _ in decision = "Approved \(id)" },
    onDenyTool: { id, _ in decision = "Denied \(id)" }
)
